basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Development of Imaging Technology (C-DIT), Thiruvananthapuram, is engaging one Consultant (Fund Realisation) in its Finance & Accounts Department, open only to retired Government officials, for an initial period of one year at a monthly consolidated remuneration of Rs.40,000 – Rs.50,000. Applicants must be officers retired from the Finance Department, Government of Kerala, or from a Public Sector Financial Institution under the Government of Kerala, and must be graduates in any discipline. Applications go in physical format or by email to [email protected] by 08.12.2026, Tuesday

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted in physical format or by email. The application in the prescribed format, with copies of certificates proving qualifications and experience, must be forwarded to The Registrar, C-DIT, Chitranjali Hills, Thiruvallom P O, Trivandrum-695027, or emailed to [email protected]. The last date is 08.12.2026, Tuesday, 5 pm. The notice does not say where the prescribed format can be obtained.

Documentary proof, if equivalence of a qualification is claimed.
Original certificates, to be submitted for verification when intimated.
Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Acceptance or rejection of an application is at the sole discretion of C-DIT and is binding on the applicant.
important_instructions: The number of posts is indicative only and may vary depending on the requirements of the client/projects. Age, qualification and experience possessed by the applicant as on the closing date of the notification only will be considered. content_sections.heading: About C-DIT
content_sections.text: C-DIT is an autonomous institution set up by the Government of Kerala, functioning under the Dept. of Electronics & IT, with its office at Chithranjali Hills, Thiruvallam P.O., Thiruvananthapuram – 695 027. The notice describes it as an approved Total Solution Provider (TSP) and Accredited Agency for Government IT initiatives. It undertakes projects in IT/ITES, e-Governance, web development, digitisation and digital transformation of Government departments and organisations.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: This engagement is open only to retired Government officials. The notice lists the following conditions for the single post. The applicant shall be an officer retired from the Finance Department, Government of Kerala, or an officer retired from a Public Sector Financial Institution under the Government of Kerala. The applicant should be a Graduate in any discipline with good experience in financial management, including debt recovery, recovery of Government dues, reduction of non-performing assets (NPAs), and related financial operations. Sound knowledge of financial procedures in Government and experience in liaisoning with Government departments. Excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. Age limit: below 65 years on the date of notification; engagement will not be considered after completing 65 years. The notice prints no age relaxation. The notification is dated 24.11.2026. Basic qualifications must be from universities or institutions recognised by the Govt of India, Govt of Kerala, Kerala PSC or empowered academic bodies. Candidates with an equivalent or higher qualification are eligible, but must furnish documentary proof when claiming equivalence. C-DIT reserves the right to decide the eligibility of any professional certificate or diploma not from a recognised university or institute. The notice prints no desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly consolidated remuneration for the consultancy is between Rs.40,000 and Rs.50,000, depending on the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate. The notice states that any other monetary or service benefit is not applicable. The engagement is temporary, initially for one year, and may be extended if C-DIT requires, at its sole discretion. The selected candidate must enter into an agreement with C-DIT in the prescribed format, on terms and conditions and service benefits prescribed by C-DIT. Appointees have no claim for regular appointment in any C-DIT establishment after the engagement ends. Posting can be anywhere in the client offices or project sites in the State of Kerala.

content_sections.heading: C-DIT Consultant (Fund Realisation) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the scope of activities as follows. Preparation and consolidation of receivables due from client departments since implementation of Projects. Coordinating with HoDs/Project Managers of C-DIT for timely issuance of invoices to clients. Liaisoning with Government departments and stakeholders for timely realisation of outstanding receivables. Identifying and consolidating possible NPAs and preparing strategies to mitigate formation of NPAs. Organising periodic internal review meetings to ensure regular fund flow from projects implemented by C-DIT. Identifying and reporting gaps existing in realisation of outstanding receivables.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for C-DIT Consultant (Fund Realisation)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted in physical format or by email. The application in the prescribed format, with copies of certificates proving qualifications and experience, must be forwarded to The Registrar, C-DIT, Chitranjali Hills, Thiruvallom P O, Trivandrum-695027, or emailed to [email protected] . The last date is 08.12.2026, Tuesday, 5 pm. The notice does not say where the prescribed format can be obtained. Documents named in the notice: Copies of certificates to prove qualifications and experience. Details of age, qualification and experience, clearly specified and supported by documents. Documentary proof, if equivalence of a qualification is claimed. Original certificates, to be submitted for verification when intimated. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Acceptance or rejection of an application is at the sole discretion of C-DIT and is binding on the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice gives the mode of selection as interview. It also says the selection process, which may include a skill test or interview, will be decided by C-DIT based on the number of applications. Initial verification and shortlisting are based on the details in the application and the copies of documents submitted. A committee constituted by C-DIT shortlists applications based on the biodata and details of previous experience. Possession of the prescribed educational qualifications alone does not qualify a candidate; selection depends on the required professional experience and proven experience in the relevant areas. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview at the centres allotted by C-DIT. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. Inclusion in the shortlist or provisional list is not a claim for engagement. The interview date and centre are not specified in the notice.
